title: The Ethical Decision Head: Operationalizing Normative Ethics in Autonomous Vehicles via Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2608.16710v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As autonomous vehicles (AVs) approach Level 4 and Level 5 operational capability [SAE International, 2018], their on- board decision systems must handle not only safety-critical locomotion but also their subsequent moral weight. This paper details the Ethical Decision Head (EDH), a deep re- inforcement learning (RL) framework that encodes ethical reasoning as a differentiable reward signal, enabling a pol- icy gradient agent to learn morally-aligned driving behavior in scenarios whose state representation is aligned with the CARLA simulation environment [Dosovitskiy et al., 2017]. Two normative frameworks are instantiated and evaluated: a Utilitarian framework minimizing total casualties and a Kan- tian framework enforcing course maintenance as a categori- cal imperative. The EDH is trained via Proximal Policy Op- timization (PPO) [Schulman et al., 2017] against a Bradley- Terry reward model [Bradley and Terry, 1952] learned from pairwis

translated_title: 伦理决策头：通过人类反馈强化学习在自动驾驶中操作化规范性伦理
translated_abstract: 摘要：随着自动驾驶汽车（AV）接近4级和5级操作能力[SAE International, 2018]，其车载决策系统不仅需要处理安全关键的移动控制，还必须应对随之而来的道德权重。本文详细介绍了伦理决策头（EDH），这是一种深度强化学习（RL）框架，将伦理推理编码为可微分的奖励信号，使策略梯度代理能够在状态表示与CARLA仿真环境[Dosovitskiy et al., 2017]对齐的场景中学习符合道德规范的驾驶行为。文中实例化并评估了两种规范性框架：一种是最小化总伤亡人数的功利主义框架，另一种是将保持车道作为绝对命令的康德式框架。EDH通过近端策略优化（PPO）[Schulman et al., 2017]进行训练，其奖励模型基于从成对偏好中学习的Bradley-Terry模型[Bradley and Terry, 1952]。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为伦理决策头（EDH）的深度强化学习框架，通过将伦理推理编码为可微分奖励信号，使自动驾驶车辆能够在CARLA仿真环境中学习符合功利主义或康德式规范伦理的驾驶行为。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Ethical Decision Head (EDH), a deep reinforcement learning framework that encodes ethical reasoning as a differentiable reward signal, enabling autonomous vehicles to learn driving behaviors aligned with utilitarian or Kantian normative ethics in the CARLA simulation environment.
